description: Get the mapping from the component instances in a node to code components: { nodeId: { codeConnectName, codeConnectSrc, label } }, plus the components that are not mapped yet. Mappings live in the project (.figma-local/code-connect.json under the working directory).

fileKey.description: The key of the Figma file. Accepted for compatibility; the file open in Figma Desktop is always used.

nodeId.description: The ID of the node, eg. "123:456" or "123-456" (instance ids like "I1:2;3:4" work too). Omit it to use the current selection in Figma.

name: get_code_connect_map
title: Get Code Connect Mapping
